# Native Read document fixtures

Deterministic synthetic document fixtures for the native `read` tool's
structured-document projection (Issue #48).

Every file here is generated by the in-repo generator
`src/tools/native/read/testdata.rs` from known constant content — a
hand-written minimal PDF writer and minimal OOXML (zip) packages with
stored (uncompressed) entries and fixed timestamps. The regression test
`committed_fixture_corpus_matches_the_in_repo_generator` asserts that these
committed bytes are byte-for-byte the generator's output, so no fixture is
an opaque binary: review the generator source to see exactly what each
document contains.

To regenerate after changing the generator:

```sh
cargo test regenerate_committed_fixture_corpus -- --ignored
git diff --stat tests/fixtures/read/documents
```

## Corpus

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `pdf/small-text.pdf` | One page, two text lines (text layer). |
| `pdf/multi-page-text.pdf` | Two pages with distinct text (page boundary). |
| `pdf/table-heavy.pdf` | One page, three two-column rows at fixed x positions. |
| `pdf/scanned-no-text.pdf` | Valid pages with no text operators (must NOT trigger OCR). |
| `docx/small.docx` | Heading, paragraphs, bullets, and a table. |
| `docx/larger.docx` | One heading plus eight numbered paragraphs. |
| `xlsx/small.xlsx` | Two named sheets with inline-string cells. |
| `xlsx/larger-sheet.xlsx` | One sheet with forty numbered rows. |
| `pptx/small.pptx` | Two titled slides with body text. |
| `pptx/larger-deck.pptx` | Four titled slides with body text. |

All files are deliberately small (hundreds of bytes to a few kilobytes).
Larger or pathological inputs used by bound tests (2000+ projected lines,
50KB crossings, oversized sources, archive-member bombs) are generated
into temporary directories at test time and are not committed.
